summary: Review A of Phase 4 at 8a3e9cb9d (provenance: phase_base_sha=7d81c7e6fd6f067431b931812baafc36cbe16f2d, role_base_sha=7d81c7e6fd6f067431b931812baafc36cbe16f2d, first Review A run of the phase; repo HEAD a1d3bb741 moved by other tracks, and `git diff --stat 8a3e9cb9d HEAD -- .github scripts measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107 apps/www-reading-advantage` prints nothing, so the audited content equals HEAD; model bailian-token-plan/glm-5.3#high, substituted for the role-table claude-opus-5-5 via `ra-quota pick review-a --not-family anthropic --not-family deepseek`). All five assigned checks hold. (1) The dry-run file reuses the helpers, guards its input, prints one labeled line per row, and edits no helper. (2) /tmp/opencode/p4-red/report-check.cjs is line-for-line the P4.6 block of test-strategy.md; R-1 to R-3 test what P4.6 says; my re-run passes with the recorded labels, and a wrong report fails by construction and by recorded runs. (3) Closeout item 6 re-run gives p4_out_of_scope_paths=0 and max header 98 characters; the task 4.1 to 4.3 evidence matches its commits; the C29 deviation holds because the 9-path closure diff abd7e30ae..7b50b8b4f is empty, so www run 4 at 7b50b8b4f proved the exact closure content of report_head abd7e30ae, and the plan records the deviation. (4) Neither www test commit weakens the test: the poster case keeps strict set equality (any file beyond the 10 WebP files and the 2 SONG_POSTERS files fails), and only the Lanczos3 case has the 20000 ms timeout. (5) The 4.4 Green items match my re-runs, the four guard known failures are exactly the P2.5 items 1 to 4, and deviation 2 holds because the P2 green log itself ran marketing and codecamp from their app folders for the same `@/` alias reason with identical counts. A3, A4, and A5 are clean over the delta. One Nit: the www text table class word 'test only' deviates from the C28 vocabulary 'text or no-text'. Limitation: the sandbox rejected the shell redirect form, so mutated report fixtures were not written; the wrong-report verdict uses the check code, my live re-run, and the recorded Red, Green, and strategy runs.

Check 1, dry-run file: scripts/ci/__tests__/dry-run.test.mjs (243 lines) imports readTable, planRepo, removePlanScratch, runSelect, selectStep, stepText, and workflow from ./helpers/plan.mjs and removeScratchDirs and requireNonEmpty from ./helpers/scratch.mjs, so it reuses the helpers of P2.3. Input guards: DR-00 runs requireNonEmpty(TABLE) and asserts table_rows=10 and select_secret_refs=0 before the loop; each DR case runs requireNonEmpty(ids); DR-11 asserts changed_files>=1; matrixIds musts on a missing or non-array matrix; assertCleanRun musts on status!=0 or any gcloud call; afterAll asserts dry_run_rows=11. One labeled line per row: each case prints one DRYRUN line of the form `DRYRUN row=<id> mode=<mode> range=<path> cd_www=<yes|no> cd_apps=[...] ci=[...] gcloud_calls=<n> select_secret_refs=0`, and DR-11 adds changed_files and ci_ranges. No helper edit: `git diff --stat 7d81c7e6 8a3e9cb9d -- scripts/ci .github/workflows` prints only the new file `scripts/ci/__tests__/dry-run.test.mjs | 243 insertions`; `git diff --stat 931c9f2a5 8a3e9cb9d -- scripts/ci` and `git diff --stat 931c9f2a5 HEAD -- scripts/ci/__tests__` print nothing, so the Red file is unchanged and the helpers were never touched.

Check 2, report check text: /tmp/opencode/p4-red/report-check.cjs (72 lines) matches the P4.6 code block of test-strategy.md (lines 783 to 854) statement for statement: the missing-file early exit, the ^name: 40-hex field regex, the section slicer, the rowsOf table parser, R-1 (row count equals table ids plus ci, bidirectional id-set equality, bad_rows on gcloud_calls=0 and EXIT=0), R-2 (one first_push_plan line; head_match, base_match, commits_match against live `git rev-list --count`, affected_match against a live `node scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs --base <origin> --head <head>` run, traffic, no_traffic, skipped from the apps.json table modes, affected_ids>=1), R-3 (a live `git diff --name-only <www_live_sha> <head>` over the four closure paths, files_match set equality, textRows equal to plan_www_text_changes, held_signin_copy_in_head against a live git grep), and the pass/fail exit. The check recomputes every count from git and the script, so it does not trust the report's own numbers.

Check 2, wrong report fails: the check code fails a wrong report on each axis by construction (R-1 on a missing or extra row, a wrong id, or a row without gcloud_calls=0 and EXIT=0; R-2 on a wrong head, base, commit count, or id list; R-3 on a missing www row, a wrong live sha, a wrong text count, or a wrong held line). Recorded negative runs agree: the plan 4.1 Red evidence and the P4.3 prediction give EXIT=1 with `missing measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/dry-run-report.md report_rows=0 first_push_plan_lines=0` on the absent report; the green log turn 1 (lines 10 to 11) gives `first_push_plan_lines=0, report_check=fail failed=R-2` with EXIT=1 on the report without the plan line; test-strategy P4.5 records report_partials_rejected=5 report_good_passed=1 (no ci row, gcloud_calls=1, storytime dropped, head mismatch, and a wrong www_live_sha with an empty table each failed). Limitation: this sandbox rejected the shell redirect form (two attempts), so I wrote no mutated fixtures; my own live run covers the positive case, and the negative case rests on the code reading and the recorded runs above.

Check 3, closeout item 6 scope: `git log --name-only --format='--- %h %s' bf80408eb..8a3e9cb9d --grep='track_id: per_app_cicd_20261107'` lists 15 commits (931c9f2a5, 3e8bc64bd, 165bdb178, b5d7a1e8a, 0328f0e05, f281a9c76, bc040073b, 583196142, 7b50b8b4f, 64d147aa7, 012b02f1f, 391578269, 8a3e9cb9d, plus 4898143fe and 7d81c7e6f below the phase base), and every one touches only measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/plan.md, measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/dry-run-report.md, measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/test-strategy.md, or scripts/ci/__tests__/dry-run.test.mjs, so p4_out_of_scope_paths=0 over the item 6 set. The longest header is `chore(measure): add the p4 phase check and fix the b1 proof line (track_id: per_app_cicd_20261107)` at 98 characters, matching the plan claim. No dependency file and no workflow, script, table, or build file changed: `git diff --stat bf80408eb 8a3e9cb9d -- scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs scripts/ci/apps.json .github/workflows 'apps/*/cloudbuild*.yaml'` prints nothing.

Check 4, the two www test commits: 03307ccb2 (7 insertions, 4 deletions, one file) renames the poster case and changes the expected list to [...STORYTIME_IMAGES names .webp, ...Object.values(SONG_POSTERS) basenames]; the assertion stays a strict toEqual on the sorted readdirSync list, so any file other than the 10 WebP files and the 2 SONG_POSTERS files fails, and any missing file fails too; the per-WebP lossless and dimension checks are unchanged. SONG_POSTERS in apps/www-reading-advantage/src/__tests__/fixtures/storytime-page-expected.ts lines 132 to 135 holds exactly 2 poster paths. abd7e30ae (1 insertion, 1 deletion, one file) adds `, 20000` to the `it` that closes at line 107, the 'contains exactly the selected crop resized with Lanczos3' case only; the other two cases carry no explicit timeout and all assertions are unchanged, so a pixel difference still fails.

Check 5, the 4.4 Green items: the plan 4.4 record and the green log (turn 4 step 3 and the final block) list the same nine guard results, and known_failures=4 other_failures=0 matches the P2.5 items 1 to 4 exactly (packages/db 1: codecamp-0049 ceiling; codecamp 2: phase-10 auth session schema and launch gate; sales 1: the approval gate). The counts equal the P2 green log gate table (green-p2-413467c3a.log lines 215 to 222 and 285 to 292): storytime 12, db 28 passed 1 failed, accounting 18, accounts 9, marketing 15, domain 10, sales 28 passed 1 failed, codecamp 86 passed 2 failed 47 skipped. Deviation 2 holds: the P2 log itself ran marketing and codecamp from their app folders ('run in apps/marketing', 'run in apps/codecamp-advantage') because the root run fails to load the `@/` alias ('Cannot find package '@/lib/company-oidc''), with identical counts, and the P3 science row expects 40 passed, which the P4 run reproduced from the app dir. The codecamp 47 skipped and storytime 12 counts are the same as P2, so no coverage was lost between the phases.

A3 check: every count in the plan 4.1 to 4.4 record and in the report is a labeled integer (report_rows=11, expected_rows=11, first_push_plan_lines=1, affected_ids=10, commits=434, www_closure_files_changed=1, www_text_changes=0, known_failures=4, tests_failed=0), and the check parses structure and command output rather than bare digits. No bare-digit count assertion was found in the delta.

A4 check: no vacuous pass. The missing report file exits 1 with the missing line (recorded Red run); DR-00 asserts table_rows=10 before the loop; DR-11 asserts changed_files>=1 before it accepts empty matrices; R-2 requires affected_ids>=1; R-3 needs the computed closure diff before it accepts www_text_changes=0 (a missing www_live_sha line gives files_match=0); a missing '## Dry runs' section gives rows=0 against expected 11. The 4.2 gate needs www_tasks_seen=2, which the turbo log names.

The heavy www run 4 labels (EXIT=0, 1980 passed 0 failed) are plan-recorded and green-log-recorded with the same numbers. No note claims a deploy, a traffic move, or the B1 live proof; the plan states the C30 limit in plain words.

Framework-wide checks were applied because the phase touched scripts/ci: pattern drift is absent (the dry-run file follows the P4.3 harness spec and the helper API of P2.3), no unnecessary abstraction was added (the local functions are all used and small), the phase changed no production contract (no workflow, script, table, or build file changed since bf80408eb), and no caller coverage gap exists (the select-step contract was already covered by the P2 and P3 cases; the new file characterizes it per row).
